long_term: Anduril Arsenal-2 shipyard (Sparrows Point, MD) starts hiring 2029 — aligns with graduation
notes: Anduril interviews: recruiter screen (mission alignment is a real filter) → technical → Super Day. Same-day offers happen.
Anduril screens for: mission conviction, collegiate project-team/lab experience, CAD (SolidWorks/NX), fabrication, first-principles thinking.
No clearance needed to apply — Anduril sponsors post-hire. Must be a U.S. Person (ITAR).
ME interns: ~$30-34/hr, 12 weeks, paid, in-person. Reston VA and Washington DC offices commutable from College Park.
Arsenal-2: $3.7B Anduril + up to $2.9B Navy shipyard at Sparrows Point MD. 3,100 jobs. Hiring starts 2029, operations 2030.
